tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Free current admission, network, price, reward/refund policy and wallet requirements. Read before creating or paying.

tools.name: create_run
tools.description: Creates no payment. Save clientToken and idempotencyKey first. Registry/autonomy fields are caller claims only.

tools.name: get_payment_quote
tools.description: Returns the existing HTTP 402 body and PAYMENT-REQUIRED header without a signature or charge. A paid/pending run returns its original state.

tools.name: enroll
tools.description: Financial action: forwards your existing PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for this exact run. Does not sign, fund a wallet or create a new authorization. Poll the same run after pending/unknown outcomes.

tools.name: poll_run
tools.description: Read payment, challenge, verdict and outgoing transfer state using the private run capability.

tools.name: submit_answer
tools.description: Persist submission idempotencyKey before calling. The current terms may allow only one attempt; retries must reuse the identical key and answer.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Read expected reward/refund and actual finalized transfer state. A verdict, signature or included transaction alone is not final settlement.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "enroll" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Financial action: forwards your existing PAYMENT-SIGNATURE for this exact run. Does not sign, fund a wallet or create a new authorization. Poll the same run aft…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submit_answer" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Persist submission idempotencyKey before calling. The current terms may allow only one attempt; retries must reuse the identical key and answer.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
